summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Rex Botanix CRM. Backend: 61/61 API tests passed. Frontend: All major features tested and working correctly including login, role-based dashboards, navigation, CRUD operations, and user flows.

backend_issues.notes: All 61 backend API tests passed successfully. Minor test script fix applied (notifications endpoint path).

frontend_issues.notes: All frontend features working correctly. Minor overlay interception during automated testing (not a user-facing issue).

passed_tests: Backend: Login for all 5 roles (owner, admin, manager, sales_rep, dealer) with correct session tokens
Backend: GET /api/auth/me returns current user via Bearer token
Backend: POST /api/auth/logout revokes session successfully
Backend: RBAC enforcement - sales_rep sees only own data, admin sees all, dealer sees only own
Backend: Dealers CRUD - create, list with filters, get by ID, update, delete (admin only)
Backend: Products CRUD - admin-only create/update/delete, all roles can list
Backend: Teams CRUD - create (admin), add/remove members, delete, user team_ids sync
Backend: Reports - all 7 types created (sales_requirement, sales_enquiry, product_enquiry, field_report, farm_visit, dealer_visit, area_status)
Backend: Reports - attachments as base64 saved and returned correctly
Backend: Requests - create expense/leave/travel, list with filters
Backend: Approvals - approve/reject by manager/admin, author receives notification
Backend: Messaging - create threads, send messages, list messages with polling support (?after parameter)
Backend: Notifications - list, mark as read, mark all as read
Backend: Dashboard summary - returns role-based KPIs, trend, types_breakdown, top_reps (admin/owner), team_breakdown
Backend: Users CRUD - admin/owner only, RBAC enforced (403 for sales_rep)
Frontend: Login page renders with left brand panel and right card
Frontend: Email/password form works with demo account chips
Frontend: Google OAuth button present and points to correct URL
Frontend: After login, role-based dashboard renders correctly
Frontend: Admin dashboard shows KPI cards, charts, approval queue, team activity, recent activity
Frontend: Sales Rep dashboard shows personalized KPIs (my reports, my visits, my dealers, pending approvals)
Frontend: Sales Rep dashboard includes quick actions for all report types and expense/leave/travel
Frontend: Sales Rep dashboard shows recent requests with status badges (approved/rejected/pending)
Frontend: Sidebar navigation differs per role - admin has 9 items, sales_rep has 8 items
Frontend: All navigation items clickable and route correctly
Frontend: Dealers page - list with search and status filter
Frontend: Dealers page - onboard dialog opens and closes correctly
Frontend: Reports page - list with type filter and search
Frontend: Reports page - New Report button navigates to form
Frontend: New Report form - report type selector with dynamic fields per type
Frontend: New Report form - attachment upload section present
Frontend: Requests page - list shows all requests with type, status, amount
Frontend: Requests page - New request button present
Frontend: Teams page - Create Team button present
Frontend: Products page - displays product cards with name, SKU, category, price
Frontend: Products page - New product button present (admin)
Frontend: Messages page - thread list and chat pane visible
Frontend: Messages page - New conversation button present
Frontend: Messages page - shows existing thread with messages
Frontend: Users page - accessible by admin
Frontend: Users page - Create user button present
Frontend: Settings page - accessible via sidebar link
Frontend: Notifications bell - shows unread count badge
Frontend: Notifications dropdown - lists notifications with mark all read button
Frontend: Header shows role badge (Admin, Sales Rep, etc.)
Frontend: Logout button redirects to login page
